candidates.title: pin-the-ci-runner-image
candidates.description: The CI job floats on ubuntu-latest; pin it so a runner bump cannot turn the suite red overnight.
candidates.rationale: Pipeline exhaust: real, small, and NOT the product.
candidates.user_visible_outcome: Nothing a user sees; the build stops breaking for reasons nobody chose.
candidates.verification_plan: Re-run CI on the pinned image and confirm the suite is green.

candidates.title: tidy-the-build-log-events
candidates.description: Build-log events are written in three shapes; normalize them.
candidates.rationale: Pipeline exhaust: hygiene on the pipeline's own artifacts.
candidates.verification_plan: Assert one shape across the suite.
